## Selected work

- [Alkemy](https://alkemy.devdashlabs.com), Key Account Intelligence agent (designed and built its core): researches a client's most important customers, finds who can introduce them, tracks progress and keeps the news up to date.
- Alkemy, introductions agent: works out who knows whom from shared employers and schools, and ranks who can make the best introduction.
- Alkemy, lead-finding agent: searches the web for companies that match a client's ideal customer; found 600+ in one search.
- Alkemy, cost reduction: cut the cost of each company research report by more than half, measured with A/B tests.
- Alkemy, quality checks: every claim in a report is checked against its source, and every agent step against its instructions.
- TradePilotAI (DevDash), prediction models: predict a stock's high, low and price swings for the day from 400+ stock and options signals, tested only on later dates.
- TradePilotAI (DevDash), trade-check agents: check news, earnings, insider trades and the economy, and can stop a trade; a full run takes under 80 seconds.
- Plain English to database queries: a T5 model that also reads the database layout; it beat a model without that on hard MongoDB queries.
- [Crop recommendation from field sensors](https://github.com/aashishpnt/IoT-Device-for-Crop-Recommendation-using-AI): wireless sensors read the soil; a machine learning model suggests what to plant.
- [Gift card platform for many businesses](https://giftcards.atrusta.com) (Atrusta): built end to end, with online payments through Stripe.
- Booking assistant for a skincare clinic (Atrusta): answers only from the clinic's own information, so it won't make up services or prices.
